text:
incident-bot: RED ALERT — sudden p95 latency regression and spikes in 5xx errors in ap-southeast-1. Auto-paging #incidents :rotating_light:

sam: paging SRE oncall, APAC customer-impact report flooding support queues

ben: oncall (SRE) here. Quick impact summary?

maria: gen endpoints p95 ~2.8s, overall error rate ~4.6% (normal <0.5%). 5 tenants show elevated qps, one tenant ~45% of regional traffic. Node-local KV eviction rates high, host CPU steal noted.

evan: telemetry shows repeatedly long-context realtime runs from that tenant leading to large KV footprint and batch packing starvation. The heavy traffic is causing cache churn and starving small requests. Recommend immediate tenant isolation to preserve tail for others.

kevin: plan: create an isolation route that cages the heavy tenant(s) into a lane with conservative qps and disabled function-calls + smaller concurrency. Canary 10% then ramp.

kevin: ```
# quarantine heavy tenants in APAC (canary)
rdw routing create --name apac-quarantine-2026 --match 'tenant in ["t-heavy-21","t-heavy-22"]' \ 
  --route-to lane:isolated-high-cost --qps 5 --max_concurrency 1 \ 
  --disable-function-calls true --region ap-southeast-1
rdw routing canary --name apac-quarantine-2026 --percent 10 --region ap-southeast-1
```

deploy-bot: routing policy apac-quarantine-2026 created. Canary rollout started at 10% in ap-southeast-1

sam: applying short-term token and concurrency caps for t-heavy-21 and t-heavy-22 while canary observes: set max_concurrent_requests=2 and daily_token_cap=80k

maria: canary telemetry looks good: canary nodes p95 ~0.95s and errors ~0.7% while region still elevated. Logs:

maria: ```
[2026-05-03T09:11:42Z] tenant=t-heavy-21 route=isolated qps=6 limit=5 action=rate_limited
[2026-05-03T09:11:47Z] cluster=ap-southeast-1 p95_canary=0.95s p95_region=1.8s errors=1.3%
```

amy: CS contacted impacted accounts; two customers acknowledged mitigations. One enterprise customer asked for guaranteed low-latency routing — we can pin them to low-latency lane temporarily.

evan: applying low-latency pin for t-enterprise-9 now. Also toggling off aggressive prefetching and batch packing for economy lane in APAC to reduce cross-tenant eviction pressure.

kevin: ```
rdw routing update --match 'tenant in ["t-enterprise-9"]' --route-to lane:low-latency --override-priority high --region ap-southeast-1
rdw feature toggle --region ap-southeast-1 --lane economy --set kv_prefetch=false,batch_pack_aggressive=false
```

deploy-bot: routing update applied; feature toggles set. t-enterprise-9 -> lane:low-latency (ap-southeast-1)

maria: after quarantine + quota caps + feature toggles, region p95 down to ~1.1s and errors ~0.9%. Canary promoted to 100% and policy at full rollout.

deploy-bot: canary complete. apac-quarantine-2026 at 100% in ap-southeast-1

ben: marking incident mitigated. Handing to morning shift: I'll stay on slack for 20m. @maria you'll take primary after that; please include rollback in the runbook.

maria: adding rollback steps to thread for runbook: 

maria: ```
# rollback apac quarantine
rdw routing delete --name apac-quarantine-2026 --region ap-southeast-1
rdw quotas set --tenant t-heavy-21 --daily_token_cap 300000 --max_concurrent_requests 8
rdw quotas set --tenant t-heavy-22 --daily_token_cap 300000 --max_concurrent_requests 8
rdw feature toggle --region ap-southeast-1 --lane economy --set kv_prefetch=true,batch_pack_aggressive=true
rdw routing update --match 'tenant in ["t-enterprise-9"]' --route-to lane:default
```

amy: CS ticket INC-1623 created and linked; customers updated with mitigation timeline and next steps. One customer requested postmortem when available.

sam: postmortem owner: evan. Action items captured: (1) automated detection & auto-quarantine for single-tenant sustained high QPS, (2) quarantine policy templates in Console, (3) conservative defaults for APAC economy lane, (4) per-tenant burst protection metrics surfaced in Console.

evan: ack. I'll draft the postmortem, add runbook entries, and prototype an auto-quarantine detector that triggers at sustained single-tenant qps > 30% region for 3m.

ben: monitoring for 2 hours before closure. Incident status: mitigated. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE — mitigated. Follow-up: postmortem required within 72 hours.
